speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis. The description of a rough, sandpaper-like plaque on the sun-exposed dorsal hand in a 65-year-old is classic for this precancerous lesion. Given your history of sunbathing and age, this is the most likely diagnosis.
